name: Grain
description: Configuration template for agricultural grain and commodity batches

fields.name: cropType
fields.label: Crop Type
fields.description: Botanical or agricultural crop variety (e.g., Wheat, Rice, Corn, Soybean, Barley)

fields.name: quantity
fields.label: Quantity
fields.description: Total quantity of the commodity lot

fields.name: unit
fields.label: Unit of Measurement
fields.description: Standardized unit of weight or volume

fields.name: warehouse
fields.label: Warehouse / Storage Facility
fields.description: Designated licensed depository or silo facility

fields.name: batchNumber
fields.label: Batch / Lot Number
fields.description: Traceable producer harvest lot or intake batch identifier

fields.name: harvestDate
fields.label: Harvest Date
fields.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the batch was harvested

evidenceRequirements.name: Electronic Negotiable Warehouse Receipt (e-NWR)
evidenceRequirements.description: Regulated warehouse receipt establishing depository custody

evidenceRequirements.name: Producer Batch / Intake Lot Certificate
evidenceRequirements.description: Traceable intake certificate certifying harvest origin and weight

evidenceRequirements.name: Quality Assay & Grading Certificate
evidenceRequirements.description: Certified laboratory report confirming crop grade, moisture, and purity
